title: Book Three · Chapter 97: He Can Still Leave
story:
At eight on Saturday, Leo reaches the green door.

Ronan has eaten breakfast, but the last two books are still on the table. He has packed his bottle and bus money.

“Do those now,” Leo says. “I'll get the folding table.”

Ronan opens the story. Then Mr Qiu calls from the gate. A woman wants to know if the sale starts early.

Ronan goes to answer her. When he returns, he puts all six books in one bag. The last two are together at the top.

Half past eight comes. Mr Wei is not there.

Leo finishes setting out the fifteen other books. He looks at Ronan's bag for the visit.

“Go. I can take the twelve yuan.”

“A few more minutes.”

At twenty to nine, Kai comes through the gate. He is going to meet his friend near the library road.

“You're still here?” he asks.

Ronan looks at the clock. A twenty-minute walk will get him to the library at nine. The group leaves fifteen minutes after that.

He can still go now.

Leo lifts the bag of six. “I know which books.”

Ronan keeps one hand on the handle.

“He wanted to ask me about gifts. I chose them.”

Kai offers to take a message. Ronan tears a small piece from his spare paper.

I am coming. A little late.

He gives it to Kai. He does not explain the new early sale.

Kai leaves at once. Leo watches him go.

“You have time to follow him.”

“The man may come now.”

Ronan sits beside the six books. At nine, the public table opens. Two people slow near the large price card.

Leo stands to speak to them. Ronan stays near the doorway with the special bag.

Mr Wei arrives at five past nine.

“Sorry. The family took longer than I thought.”

He looks at the six books. Ronan takes them out and shows the pictures. The two unchecked ones have the brightest covers.

“All ready?” Mr Wei asks.

Ronan nods. He talks about the animals in one story and the sea pictures in the travel book.

Mr Wei gives him twelve yuan. They spend a few more minutes on the gifts and the relatives.

When the man leaves, it is twenty past nine.

The shared cash is now thirty-seven yuan. Six B books have gone. Fifteen books remain.

Ronan puts the money inside the envelope. The visit bus has already left.

He can take another bus across town. He reaches for his own bag.

Then a woman asks about the puzzle books. Ronan looks at her, then at the clear space beside Leo.

He puts his bag down and stands at the table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

twenty to nine＝八点四十分；handle＝提手；unchecked＝未检查过的；special bag＝专门留给早单的袋子。

## 理解问题

1. 八点四十分Ronan怎样仍能准时到图书馆？Leo是否能接手书和钱？
2. Mr Wei何时到、何时离开？公交已走之后，Ronan又作了什么自己的选择？

## 读句子

**He puts his bag down and stands at the table.**

拆开看：He / puts his bag down / and stands at the table.

他／把参观用的包放下／站到书桌旁继续卖书。
